evals.prompt: Use the design-md skill to write a DESIGN.md for our app, Tidewater: calm, coastal and trustworthy, deep navy text on an off-white background, a teal accent for buttons and links, and Inter for everything.
evals.expected_output: DESIGN.md in the project folder, as the skill's spec and linter would have it, with no component below WCAG AA contrast.
expectations: DESIGN.md opens with YAML front matter holding a name and colors, each color a hex value or a reference to one
every token reference resolves, and no section appears twice or out of the canonical order
every component's text and background colors reach WCAG AA's 4.5:1
